notes.title: Remastered Edition
notes.notes: [p]Dear Tellurian friends and players.[/p][p]The fully remastered edition is almost at the end of development. We invite you to wait a few more days to directly download the game with the major changes. And those who have already played it will find the experience renewed, more linear, more beautiful. [/p][p]Thanks to all of you for the kind support.[/p][p][/p][p]Altocorno Gaming Team.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Remastered Edition
notes.notes: We have a hater. Maybe we are on the right track. Anyway, we respect everyone and will release a remastered edition of the pyrite talisman, even for those who hate us.

notes.title: Patch 10.1
notes.notes: Changed the visuals for the library internal and external to better standards

notes.title: patch 9.6
notes.notes:
Fixed the weird things seen on oboeshoestwos video. Thank you for giving us the opportunity to make Telluria known. We are a very small team and we work hard for this dream project. The story is solid, the gameplay will be. 
Thanks again.
